name: pod_memory_working_set_anomaly
title: Mean pod memory working set is unusually high
description: Mean memory working set per pod (k8s_pod_memory_working_set, averaged over all pod samples) is above its learned weekday/weekend hour-of-day band in at least 2 of the last 3 five-minute buckets, a sign of a leak or a memory regression. Unit: bytes. Whole cluster; add a k8s_namespace_name or k8s_deployment_name filter after install for a per-entity alert (one config per entity).
